watches.name: Pink - Unisex Blue Light Filtering Glasses (High-grade)
watches.description: Do you know just how harmful blue light from our technological devices affect our eyes and overall health? These universal clear reading glasses are specially coated to filter out blue light from computer, tv, & phone screens. Blue light exposure contributes to headaches, fatigue, dry eyes, and degrades the actual eye itself. Blue light penetrates all the way to the retina, this causes changes that resemble those of macular degeneration, which can lead to permanent vision loss. These frames are lightweight, stylish, & the easiest and safest way to protect yourself or loved ones if you or they spend a lot of time on a computer, using mobile devices, or around televisions. Do you like to watch tv at night? The blue light is actually keeping you up, but these lenses can help you rest a little easier and help with insomnia. These plastic frames are not optical, so will not correct your vision but will filter out harmful blue light.
